notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
New building added:
Clearing
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979517/af624a17141dbb6bb5defa79a6e0d16b45dcd6f0.png[/img]
Clears the cage on which the building is built, after that the cage becomes available for construction. (You can only build on inaccessible cells)
Size 1x1
You can build on any planet
The cost of 10 Etherium
